description: This file declares utility functions for retrieving environment variable values within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It provides two overloads of StringFromEnv: one returning an optional string and another returning a string with a default value.

methods.name: StringFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable as an optional string.

methods.name: StringFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable, returning the provided default if not set.
